label: Gallery modal
verdict:
Not CLEAN — a few issues found.

**(1) Overlapping / clipped UI**
- The lower-left tool panel ("Pro Tools / VIEW / Sun & Shadow…") is partially covered by the open modal. A header row is sliced right at the modal's bottom edge so only the fragment "… tools" shows — expected for an overlay, but in this frame it reads as a rendering glitch rather than clean occlusion.
- No other collisions: top toolbar, left sidebar, bottom tool chips (Tape Measure / Terrain / Excavate / Analyze / Innovate), the Sun slider bar, right-side circle buttons, and status bar all have clean separation.

**(2) 5-second comprehension**
- Mostly yes. "Community Design Gallery" with a name field, category selector, green "Save Current" button, and the empty-state line ("No designs yet. Save your current design using the bar above!") is self-explanatory, and "ADD TO YOUR YARD" + item thumbnails make the app's purpose obvious. Slightly confusing at a glance: "FPS: 1" in the status bar makes the app look frozen/broken, and nav labels like "Card" and "Innovate" are vague to newcomers.

**(3) Confusing / ambiguous / broken-looking**
- **FPS: 1** — severe rendering performance; the app will appear hung. This is the most important fix.
- **"5 ft"** label at the right end of the Sun slider bar is ambiguous — unclear whether it's sun elevation, brush size, or something else (status bar separately says "Brush: 8 ft | Height: 0 ft").
- Faint converging lines in the upper-left of the 3D canvas look like a possible z-fighting/wireframe artifact (may be intentional, worth verifying).
- Minor: modal-sliced panel text noted above; "Daytime" badge floating in the canvas is fine but slightly disconnected from the "Sun & Shadow" controls it likely relates to.

**Summary:** Layout is structurally solid and the gallery modal is clear; fix the FPS: 1 performance issue, clarify the "5 ft" slider label, and verify the line artifact in the canvas.
